reason: 'abaxial surface glabrous' of the leaf blade; the abaxial-epidermis bearer (PO_0000049) puts it in the right place.
Umbel 1-3-flowered = 1-3 flowers per inflorescence; the 'rarely 4' outlier is left out but the range is right.

target: trichome (PO_0000282) on young shoot and inflorescence axis
fix: 'ferruginous tomentellous' / 'X-coloured + hair word': the colour belongs to the indumentum (hairs), not the organ. It also holds only 'at first' (later glabrescent).
reason: The axes are not orange; their rust-coloured short tomentum is. The bearer is also the axis and young shoots, not the whole inflorescence.
The glumes (second glume and sterile lemma) are much longer than the fruit; increased length towards fruit is right.

fix: 'X except for A and B': the quality holds for the whole minus the named parts. Record the exceptions (corolla, gynostegium) or annotate the parts it applies to.
reason: Without the exception the annotation says the corolla and gynostegium are tomentose, which the flora denies.
Flower colour ranges from pink (FLOPO_0988000) to dark red (FLOPO_0988042), as stated.

fix: 'Calyx tube X': use the calyx tube class instead of collapsing to calyx.
reason: The glands are said of the calyx tube; the lobes are described separately.
Lamina 5-12 × 2-5 cm; the second figure (2-5 cm) is the width.
The stem is densely pubescent distally; the part restriction to the distal region is recorded. 'white' (hair colour) is omitted but nothing false is stated.
Calyx 3-4 mm long.
channeled = grooved (rule C196); the 'when dry' condition is recorded, and leaves spread when moist.

fix: 'non connus' / 'unknown' / 'not seen' means the organ was not observed in the material, not that it is absent. Such statements should not yield negated presence.
reason: The flora says the petals, stamens and pistil are unknown (the flowers were not collected), not that they are absent.
The culm-sheath auricles are absent; a culm sheath is a leaf sheath, so leaf sheath auricle is acceptable.
Seed capsule (fruit) globoid = spherical; 'slightly flattened' is a minor qualifier.
The branches are never lenticellate = lenticels absent. The 'rameaux' whole is not recorded but the statement holds for the shoots described.

fix: 'purplish in upper part / below the apex and on the margins': the colour is restricted to a region. Record the place slot (upper part, apical region, margin), as for 'distally' items.
reason: The bracts are pale and green below; saying the whole bract is purple is false without the 'upper part' restriction.
Petals ligulate (strap-shaped, PATO_0002430) to spathulate (PATO_0001937), shape continuum.
3 or 4 spikes; an alternative between adjacent integers equals the range 3-4.
The winter buds are not resinous; negated resinous on bud is right.
'à pétiole ... de 12–14 cm de long': petiole length 12-14 cm.

fix: '<organ> nectariferous': the organ secretes nectar. Annotate the named organ, not a free-standing nectary present on the plant.
reason: The flora says the stigma produces nectar; 'nectary present' loses the organ and suggests a separate nectary.
'no petals' = petals absent.

fix: 'abaxial faces X': substitute the abaxial-surface bearer as in A05310; the scope word 'abaxial' was dropped here.
reason: The adaxial face is described separately (glabrous or villous); the glabrous-to-tomentose range applies to the abaxial face only.
The calyx is somewhat inflated in fruit; stage fruit development (PO_0001002) is recorded.
Racemes ebracteate = bracts absent.
Veins visible on both surfaces = conspicuous, consistent with rules C176/C323 for 'distinct'/'evident' veins.
Stamens shorter than sepals.

fix: 'axis 0.2-0.5 cm, 1+ mm diam.': the measurements belong to the axis named before them. Also '1+ mm' means 1 mm or more (lower bound only), not exactly 1.
reason: The diameter is of the inflorescence axis, not the whole inflorescence; the value should be ≥1 mm.
Leaves numerous = present, count word 'many'.

fix: 'entire'/'subentire' of a leaf is the margin shape entire (PATO_0104359), not 'unstructured' (PATO_0001412, lacking distinct structure).
reason: Subentire means the margin is nearly without teeth; 'unstructured' says something else.
